verdict.summary: The documentation-only change is accurate and appropriately scoped. Commit f85d0180 exists on origin/sq-p6p6-adaptive-replan-local and is not an ancestor of main; it contains the default-off adaptive-replan-local feature, the non-vacuous replan_result_equals_static oracle, and the in-process benchmark. The text now correctly states that sparq-replan-policy was consumed only by the local evaluator while the federated planner retained its richer latency-aware policy, so convergence and drift prevention remain outstanding. research/adaptive-replan-local-evaluator.md §2.2 supports the narrower performance conclusion: the headline fixture had no pruning arm, while collapse_graph had one but only printed rather than asserted its switch count. No correctness, soundness, security, test-validity, or injection issue is present. Round 2 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
